# Ozzy's Equipment Hire

> Melbourne-based hire company supplying VMS signs, LED trailer signs and LED screen trailers across Victoria, Australia. Delivery, setup and programming are included; day rates start at $60 per day ex GST on longer contracts.

The whole business lives on one page — the links below are section anchors on that page, not separate documents. Enquiries are handled by phone (0469 316 068), email or the quote form; there is no online checkout and no account system.

## Services

- [VMS sign hire](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#services): Variable message sign trailers for traffic management, roadworks and construction site safety. Programmed to your schedule.
- [LED trailer sign hire Melbourne](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#services): Towable LED trailer signs for festivals, sport, retail activations and roadside campaigns. Also called trailer LED sign hire.
- [LED screen trailer hire](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#services): Mobile LED screen trailers for events, outdoor advertising and public messaging. Also called LED trailer screen hire or mobile trailer LED screen hire.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/): Overview of every hire service, with the enquiry path.
- [Service areas](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#areas): Suburbs and regions covered for delivery.
- [Hire guide](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#hire-guide): Which trailer suits which job — VMS vs LED sign vs LED screen.
- [Pricing](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#pricing): Day-rate calculator; rates scale with hire length.
- [FAQ](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#faq): Answers on cost, coverage, delivery and equipment types.
- [About](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#about): Who runs the business and how it operates.
- [Contact](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#contact): Phone 0469 316 068, email ozzysequipmenthire@gmail.com, or the quote form — send dates, site location and which unit you need.

## Service area

- [Melbourne and Victoria coverage](https://www.ozzysequipmenthire.com.au/#areas): Melbourne CBD, Southbank and Docklands, Richmond, South Yarra, Footscray, Dandenong, Frankston and the Mornington Peninsula, plus Geelong, Ballarat, Bendigo, Gippsland and regional Victoria.
